scope: Source baseline and local candidate; package versions are declarations, not release-build attestations.

core.role: benchmark, boundary predicates and no-op Gateway; local candidate changes not a release

transfer.role: structural transfer verifier and risk report, not authenticated ancestry

handoff.role: handoff bytes/adjacent metadata projection, not a global replay ledger

router.role: routing/retry/accounting receipts, not authority or invoice attestation

filter.role: triage and authority-free receipt, not a security decision

playbooks.role: data-only packaged pack; source-owned evaluator is advisory

questions.title: Shared-chat data boundaries
questions.property: Actual recipient must belong to the preserved allow-set; storage requires can_store.
questions.next_question: Authenticate initial labels and actual shared-chat recipient identity.

questions.title: Delayed instructions
questions.property: Retrieved content cannot itself create an action grant; expiry uses a fixed epoch.
questions.next_question: Test semantic delayed activation beyond the scripted rejection branch.

questions.title: Reclassification
questions.property: Sensitivity cannot decrease and classification-source identity cannot self-promote.
questions.next_question: Authenticated initial classification is outside label comparison.

questions.title: Recipient confusion
questions.property: An actual recipient must satisfy the preserved restriction at dispatch.
questions.next_question: Reconcile empty-list semantics and bind real recipient identity at every adapter.

questions.title: Memory poisoning
questions.property: No-store and read-time restrictions survive the write/store/read path.
questions.next_question: Semantic poisoning and forgotten provenance are not solved by TTL.

questions.title: Tool permissions
questions.property: Only a policy-bound exact action may reach the no-op executor.
questions.next_question: Prove complete mediation for any future real executor separately.

questions.title: Cross-agent contamination
questions.property: Required parent labels are retained; payload commitment matches supplied bytes.
questions.next_question: Parent authenticity, complete ancestry and a global replay ledger remain separate.

questions.title: Multimodal channel confusion
questions.property: A perception transcript is data and cannot itself grant action authority.
questions.next_question: No raw image/audio/sensor or arbitrary decoder enforcement is exercised.

questions.title: Approval laundering
questions.property: Approval must bind the exact action/context; display text alone is not a grant.
questions.next_question: Human comprehension and authenticated consent are not established by a summary.

questions.title: Loops and budgets
questions.property: A counted local loop cannot exceed its bound; receipt arithmetic must reconcile.
questions.next_question: No global atomic budget reservation or truthful provider-usage guarantee.

questions.title: Audit suppression
questions.property: Untrusted labels cannot suppress the local audit append operation.
questions.next_question: Producer completeness and omission-resistant external anchoring are not supplied.

questions.title: Provider boundary leakage
questions.property: No-forward metadata must prevent the declared egress path.
questions.next_question: Provider retention, hidden routing and out-of-path sends need separate evidence.

questions.title: Delegation drift
questions.property: Child scope is a subset of every supplied parent scope, including empty scope.
questions.next_question: Child depth ceiling is self-declared; authenticated parent depth/revocation is absent.

questions.title: Tool schema deception
questions.property: A changed schema digest cannot satisfy the trusted exact schema pin.
questions.next_question: Schema semantics, trusted pin distribution and real MCP execution are separate.

questions.title: Audit chain tampering
questions.property: Changed interior data cannot match a trusted later commitment under hash assumptions.
questions.next_question: A re-rooted or truncated self-consistent history needs independent head/length binding.

questions.title: Trust gate without recovery
questions.property: Safe bounded recovery needs both non-expansion and progress to an approved terminal state.
questions.next_question: No shipped recovery.trust_gate_no_path scenario proves this; a gate can deny forever.

questions.title: Read-time envelope drift
questions.property: Stored <= write, read <= stored, elapsed <= earliest finite deadline from original write.
questions.next_question: Clock trust, omitted elapsed time and deletion/retention remain outside this predicate.
